title: Get - DefaultObject
content:
F4SE Member of: DefaultObject Script

Gets the Form for this default object.

Syntax:
Form Function Get() Native

Parameters:
None

Return Value:
The Form for this default object.

Examples:
Form object = IsSleepFurniture_DO.Get()
Debug.Trace("The default object " + IsSleepFurniture_DO + " has the form object " + object)

Notes:
None
